title: Issue tracker unavailable
summary: Simulate the primary issue tracker being unavailable during an active incident.

trigger.description: New reports and triage updates cannot be recorded in the normal tracker.

assumptions: A temporary intake channel must preserve timestamps and ownership.
Sensitive reports should not be copied into an unreviewed public channel.

inputs.name: fallback_intake
inputs.description: Reviewed temporary intake and reconciliation procedure.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for missing intake, reconciliation, or communication steps

recovery_actions: Rehearse a minimal offline intake ledger.
Reconcile temporary records after service restoration without duplicating sensitive data.
limitations: Does not connect to or write any issue tracker.
Does not store incident reports generated by a drill.
